entities.summary: Eliseu Lemos Padilha was a Brazilian lawyer and politician, who was appointed by then-President Dilma Rousseff as the minister of the Brazilian Civil Aeronautics Government Department. He was in office from 1 January 2015 to 1 December 2015. He also served as minister of Transport and Infrastructure between 1997 and 2001 and for four terms as federal congressman of the state of Rio Grande do Sul, his birthplace.
